subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Should the Bedrock memory credential gate skip IMDS for no-signal auto-detection, and what live no-signal plus explicit AWS default-chain proof is required before this issue can close?
rationale: The source root cause is clear, but the fix touches an auth-provider/security boundary where automation cannot choose the acceptable compatibility tradeoff for EC2/ECS/profile/SSO/default-chain users.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox/log proof plus one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain proof before landing the linked PR.

options.title: Accept source-backed proof
options.body: Merge the linked PR after exact-head CI if maintainers accept dependency-source proof and the contributor's no-signal runtime output as enough for this bounded behavior change.

options.title: Narrow or reject the boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a revised approach if maintainers want IMDS/default-chain auto-detection preserved more broadly by default.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox/log proof plus one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain proof before landing the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from recent work on the current Bedrock memory adapter boundary and prior credential-gate fix history.
